{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.82

|gr1= GUI Control - Positioning

|descr= Switches mode of pixel precision (rounding) in a given control interface.

|s1= control [[ctrlSetPixelPrecision]] mode

|p1= control: [[Control]]

|p2= mode: [[Number]] or [[String]] - can be one of the following:
* 0 / "AUTO" - control position (x, y, w, h) is always rounded to whole pixels (game default)
* 1 / "ON" - control position (x, y, w, h) is rounded to whole pixels only when not animating
* 2 / "OFF" - control position (x, y, w, h) is always precise, no pixel rounding applies here

|r1= [[Nothing]]

|x1= <sqf>_control ctrlSetPixelPrecision 2; // Enables pixel precision of the given control</sqf>

|seealso= [[ctrlCommit]] [[ctrlCreate]] [[ctrlDelete]] [[ctrlModel]] [[ctrlSetModel]] [[ctrlPosition]] [[ctrlClassName]] [[displayCtrl]] [[ctrlModelScale]] [[ctrlSetModelScale]] [[ctrlModelDirAndUp]] [[ctrlSetModelDirAndUp]] [[ctrlSetPosition]]
}}
